question: How many books are sold in India annually (physical books + e-books)?
idealClarificationQuestions: All categories: academic, fiction, non-fiction, religious? All.
Both English + Indian languages? All languages.
Pirated books not counted (only formal sales)? Only formal.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Frame the approach
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Bottom-up: school textbooks + trade books + religious + competitive exam books.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: School textbooks (NCERT + state boards + private): ~30 crore students × 6-8 books/year = ~210 crore = 2.1 billion units.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Trade fiction + non-fiction: ~80M units/year (Penguin, Westland, Rupa, regional).

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Total formal sales: ~1.0-1.1 billion books per year (~50% are textbooks).

benchmarkAssumptions.value: ~30 crore students × 6-8 books/year = ~210 crore = 2.1 billion units.

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: Of these, NCERT/govt distributed (often free or subsidized)

benchmarkAssumptions.value: ~100M units (Gita Press alone prints 100M+ over years; annual ~30-50M).
~1.0-1.1 billion books per year (~50% are textbooks).

calculationFlow: School textbooks (NCERT + state boards + private): ~30 crore students × 6-8 books/year = ~210 crore = 2.1 billion units.
Of these, NCERT/govt distributed (often free or subsidized): ~70% = ~1.5B; commercial sales: ~600M.
Trade fiction + non-fiction: ~80M units/year (Penguin, Westland, Rupa, regional).
Religious + spiritual: ~100M units (Gita Press alone prints 100M+ over years; annual ~30-50M).
Total formal sales: ~1.0-1.1 billion books per year (~50% are textbooks).

finalAnswerRange.ideal: Total formal sales: ~1.0-1.1 billion books per year (~50% are textbooks).
